# French (`fr`) style for graph overlays

Overlay file: `src/data/graph.fr.json`.

- Natural editorial French, not word-for-word.
- Standard French names for places and instruments when one exists (Londres, Batterie,
  Cor d’harmonie).
- Genre names: use the usual French term when one exists (Rock alternatif), otherwise keep the original
  (Soul, House). Lowercase genre names in running text, as in French usage.
- Typography: curly apostrophe `’`; guillemets `« … »` with spaces inside; a space before `; : ! ?`.
- Dates and eras: `1er août 1981`, `années 1980`, `XVIIIe siècle`, BCE as `av. J.-C.`.
